questions.question: Which unit is used for the chromatic dispersion parameter?

explanations.b: Correct. D is given in picoseconds per nanometre of spectral width per kilometre of fiber.
explanations.d: Incorrect. This is the unit of attenuation.

questions.question: What does dispersion do to a light pulse in a fiber?

explanations.c: Correct. The pulse spreads out in time as it travels.

answers.a: Different wavelengths travelling at different speeds
answers.b: Two polarization modes travelling at different speeds

explanations.b: Correct. Fiber birefringence makes the two orthogonal modes travel at different speeds.

questions.question: What is the approximate dispersion of standard single-mode fiber at 1550 nm?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Zero dispersion is near 1310 nm.

questions.question: Pulse broadening from chromatic dispersion increases with:

explanations.a: Correct. Δτ = D × L × Δλ, so it grows with length.
